description: Gets a mobile proxy onto an IP that is on no spam/abuse blacklist: rotates, checks the new IP and repeats up to max_attempts, in one call instead of chaining rotate_ip and get_proxy_status. With keep_if_clean=true it checks the current IP first and keeps it when clean. Returns status="cooldown" with wait_seconds when the carrier refuses another rotation yet. Active connections drop on each rotation. Mobile proxies only (proxy_type=0), free of charge.

keep_if_clean.description: Check the current IP first and skip rotation if it is clean

name: rotate_until_clean
title: Rotate until the IP is clean
